prompt:

Header text verbatim: "en likhet". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "similarity".
Scene: Two framed landscape paintings with same curved bridge but different seasons, adult points to matching bridge shapes, subtle matching outlines.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "likhet = similarity; a feature shared by different things.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Jag ser en likhet mellan bilderna.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
